title: product-image list query
description: PROPOSAL product-images §4.3: the query of GET /api/v1/sync/product-images?after={productId}&max={n}, written as a JSON object (parameter => value). Both optional. Headers: the §3 sync headers, as on sync/pull.

after.description: nextAfter of the previous page; empty or left out for the first page.

max.description: Most entries in the page, 1 to 5000; 1000 when left out.
